target.name: Unone spatial SDK public authoring
target.scope: SDK-only public CLI/docs/canonical types and headless CPU spatial authoring, with supplementary informed native/tiny-input and freshly built WASM CPU/WebGPU main/Worker regression. Excludes renderer, speedup benchmark, device-loss, persistent saves and cross-platform certification.
target.revision: New release SDK CLI SHA256 b05484098012607e5e65f9d5926711061eda94de0f31d7d7ddbaaa188853111d; checkout 7b9424cf42d0409633c9ce782503075bd09018f9 with preserved concurrent changes; selected hashes identify bounded reviewed inputs.
target.environment: Windows x64, official Luau 0.734, new release CLI/WASM, Edge 155.0.4283.62 with actual WebGPU; synthetic local fixtures; existing local toolchains, no install/account/deployment/game edits.

limitations: Aggregate is an informed implementation retest. Only the separately sealed SDK author is fresh-context/blind. Source review, tests and later replay are not relabelled as blind authorship.

Trial counters use the fresh author positive operation IDs, excluding recorder bootstrap 000. First actual strict analyzer passes at 026, first submission at 027 and delivered geometry at 028. Later verifier/tool repairs are retained and separate from the first-use task.

The first official check attempt failed on PowerShell-generated JSON BOM before analyzer invocation. Later no-Python, process-policy and PowerShell vector-syntax failures are retained. No Luau type or native run failed before first delivered geometry.

Root informed probes also retain a pcall contextual-type/local-shadow failure and a Node entities-shape assertion mistake. The repaired probe-v3 changes only fixture/verification code, not the product. Final probes were actually rerun with expanded identical inputs, not legitimized by replacing hashes.
The recorder replay copies only the three sealed headless inputs, not presentation/AGENTS files, to fresh OS temp and checks geometry again. It is not another fresh author trial.
Empty Lua table array identity is not preserved by generic observation JSON. This is a retained follow-up limitation; no promise of [] for zero-hit tables or every nested array type is inferred.
The prior sparse-vector validator finding for direct malformed JavaScript callers remains outside this canonical Luau authoring scope; it is not claimed fixed by these four P2 changes.

Full Web info is published during start, before external-backend configuration, so that snapshot names cpu. Update and host reports verify actual WebGPU backend; the evidence does not claim the start snapshot already names WebGPU.
Numeric normalization fixes invalid contact normals. Existing f32 tiny-distance/selection arithmetic and GPU tolerance limits remain; no exact cross-device geometry/digest promise is made.

Scores cover all ten scoped questions only. This SDK/release task differs from the prior repository/debug scope; do not present a numerical before/after comparison or a universal AI-native certification.

Source fingerprints are selected inputs, not immutable source snapshots. Only the blind artifacts have a detached seal. One author and bounded fixtures do not establish statistical usability or full engine/device coverage.

An independent semantic reviewer checked the sealed author artifacts, final capture/source/probe hashes and scoring. Actual gate remains needs_work because 76.25 is below the fixed 80 threshold; no critical blocker is present. Task success and four P2 closures are distinct from the aggregate gate.

value.meaning: 固定 rubric 的證據支持分數（0–100 下限），不是普遍有效的 AI-native 認證。未驗證項未從分母移除。

dimensions.title: 用途與起點
dimensions.question: 陌生 AI 從入口能否說明工具解決什麼、不解決什麼，以及下一個正確操作？
dimensions.answer: A fresh AI used only the newly packed SDK entrypoints and linked public guide, correctly distinguishing generic geometry/execution from caller-owned movement and selection policy.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain the clear ownership and v1 limits, and keep SDK entrypoints synchronized with the canonical guide.

dimensions.title: 能力與限制發現
dimensions.question: 如何查到目前版本真正可用的功能、相依條件與未實作能力，而不是猜 API？
dimensions.answer: The actual new SDK contains the complete canonical guide and types. Public descriptors link it, and collision/Chinese queries now find spatial methods.
dimensions.nextAction: Preserve package inventory/link regressions and improve unrelated discovery only when backed by concrete author intent.

dimensions.title: 可執行操作契約
dimensions.question: 只靠可發現的契約及最小例子能否完成代表任務？輸入欄位、回傳及副作用是否明確？
dimensions.answer: The original authored Luau passed its first actual official analyzer invocation and both native runs. At operation 28 it delivered masked nearest, ID-sorted overlap and moving-target sweep with no casts, adapters or source fallback.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep the independent example and oracle as a regression; add a new fresh trial after future contract changes.

dimensions.title: 上下文與需求真相
dimensions.question: 是否保留 ID、關聯、版本、來源與待決事項？AI 能否取得必要脈絡而不把推測當需求？
dimensions.answer: Frozen body/query inputs survive caller mutation, failed replacement, packed version-2 repair and index destruction. Version-1 and version-2 results arrive in order and ticket usage returns to zero.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep version and lifetime semantics discoverable without implying persistent handle restoration.

dimensions.title: 結果與狀態觀察
dimensions.question: 如何查到實際變更、進度、完成、失敗與限制？是否把已送出、執行成功、人類驗收分開？
dimensions.answer: Complete info, batch and individual result records now publish directly with canonical strict types; max-u32 ID and numeric safe_integer survive native and fresh WASM execution.
dimensions.nextAction: Define a generic empty-array observation representation before promising stable JSON array identity, and retain direct publication/type-negative regressions.

dimensions.title: 具體錯因與修復
dimensions.question: 故意做錯一次：回應是否指出錯誤碼、欄位或物件、實際值與預期、具體原因及可採取的修復？修正後重跑是否成功？
dimensions.answer: Duplicate replacement, negative radius, same-tick take and consumed ticket produce actionable errors, and the respective continuation/repair succeeds.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain stable spatial error codes and consider structured field/actual/expected recovery details.

dimensions.title: 重試、衝突與恢復
dimensions.question: 重複請求、狀態過時、失去回覆或中斷時，AI 能否判斷安全重試、續接或需人類介入，不重複副作用？
dimensions.answer: Rejected replacement preserves version 1; a packed repair returns exactly version 2. Caught early take does not consume work; next-tick delivery succeeds, and consumed-ticket reuse is rejected without corrupting state.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep validation versus terminal executor faults distinct and schedule separate device-interruption coverage when that scope is requested.

dimensions.title: 權限與作用範圍
dimensions.question: 讀寫、目標專案／裝置、批准與外部副作用是否可查且實際受到限制？以一個越界操作驗證。
dimensions.answer: Only new synthetic local projects and engine/SDK artifacts are used. The fresh example and replay verify an unrelated scene entity remains unchanged through queries, mutation of caller tables and index destruction.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain geometry-only APIs and opaque handles; keep movement, policy and game responses in caller Luau.

dimensions.title: 效能與成本定位
dimensions.question: 能否觀察這類工具相關的耗時、資源或成本及瓶頸？無法量測是否明說而不回傳假零？不要求每種工具都有 GPU 指標。
dimensions.answer: The release CLI exposes measured CPU phase/frame/resource telemetry and actual backend/usage. Guide and author correctly retain O(B×Q), per-dispatch upload/readback and no speedup promise.
dimensions.nextAction: Expose spatial-cost attribution or explicit unavailability and profile bounded end-to-end workloads before choosing automatic thresholds.

dimensions.title: 版本與可重現驗證
dimensions.question: 能否保留版本指紋、環境、輸入、輸出及可重跑步驟？如何知道修改後原失敗案例確實已修复？
dimensions.answer: The SDK executable/analyzer are identified by hash, 33 selected inputs are fingerprinted, all three final probes use identical subjects, and the sealed blind evidence is verified. The informed public case also confirms nonempty equal same-seed digests.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain this failed/successful evidence and use another fresh author for future first-use claims.
